jobs.title: Head of DeFi
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Monad Foundation is a team of dedicated ecosystem and community builders who are on a mission to massively grow the impact of decentralized tech. We believe that the Monad blockchain--the performant and parallel EVM Layer 1--will help decentralized apps eat the world.

The Role

Monad Foundation, a core contributor to the Monad protocol, is looking for a Head of DeFi to lead the strategy, relationships, and hands-on execution that grows DeFi across the Monad network. This is a player-coach role: you'll set the roadmap and get into the weeds, advising builders on protocol design, orchestrating asset onboarding, deploying incentives with discipline, and ensuring the DeFi stack on Monad is robust and capital-efficient.

You should be the person who can explain how any top protocol on DefiLlama makes money, open a Monad-native protocol's frontend and produce a sharp assessment of what's working and what isn't, and then get on a call with a TradFi executive and explain why on-chain yield infrastructure matters. You hold the full DeFi picture in your head, and you turn that knowledge into TVL, volume, and fees.

What You Will Do

  • Own DeFi growth strategy for the Monad network. You will prioritize bets across lending, DEXs, stablecoins, RWAs, and yield infrastructure, measured by TVL, volume, stablecoin market cap, RWA market cap, and fees generated.

  • Execute end-to-end asset and protocol onboarding. You will coordinate across oracles, liquidators, DEX pool setup, curators, and bridging providers.

  • Advise DeFi builders deploying on the Monad network. With high-conviction, you will provide actionable feedback on protocol mechanics, product gaps, and market positioning.

  • Activate your network of liquid funds, curators, and blue-chip DeFi founders to kickstart early liquidity and protocol traction.

  • Bridge DeFi and TradFi/Fintech. You will represent the Foundation with senior institutional executives, translating yield generation opportunities (e.g., Morpho vaults on the Monad network) into strategic terms they act on.

  • Drive incentive strategy. You will form and defend opinions on which initiatives attract durable TVL per unit of spend versus which produce mercenary capital.

  • Manage a team of 2–3 DeFi specialists. You will set priorities, maintain execution tempo, and build a culture of rigor and bias for action.


Who You Are

  • DeFi-fluent operator. You have a track record of driving measurable growth in TVL, liquidity, or protocol adoption. You understand value flows across lending (Aave, Morpho, Euler), CDPs, DEXs, and yield-bearing stablecoins — and can explain what each category needs to get right to win.

  • Opinionated on asset quality and risk. You can research a new interest-bearing asset and quickly assess bridging mechanics, liquidity depth, redemption windows, reserve transparency, and issuer controls.

  • Deep, pre-existing network. With a network among liquid crypto-native funds, DeFi curators, and blue-chip protocol founders, you bring the rolodex on day one.

  • Executive presence. Credible with TradFi/Fintech C-suite; able to make DeFi concepts legible to institutional decision-makers without dumbing them down.

  • Strategic and organized. You see the full DeFi chessboard, prioritize ruthlessly, and know when to move fast versus when to build consensus.

  • Proven leadership and management experience. You have run a small, high-output team with clear direction and high trust.

  • Efficient communicator, written and verbal. You distill complexity into clarity without losing nuance.

Nice to Haves

  • Strong knowledge of trading/markets; able to think in expected value (EV) terms.

  • Experience deploying or managing liquidity across multiple chains.

  • Comfort reading Solidity and understanding smart contract risk at a conceptual level.

  • Experience working within a foundation, DAO, or decentralized contributor structure.

Why Work with Us

  • Challenging problems. You’ll tackle deeply complex and technically demanding problems, with autonomy and impact.

  • Endless Opportunity for Impact. The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) standard is ubiquitous, but existing EVM-compatible chains are slow and bandwidth-constrained. Monad’s core innovations offer developers and founders the best of both worlds (portability and performance) and are a game-changer to power global on-chain finance.

  • The right team. You’ll be part of a world class team, who are exceptional and highly-motivated.

  • Culture. We’re a lean team working together to achieve very ambitious goals. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output.

  • Strong Ecosystem. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.

jobs.title: Head of Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Monad Foundation is a team of dedicated ecosystem and community builders who are on a mission to massively grow the impact of decentralized tech. We believe that the Monad blockchain--the performant and parallel EVM Layer 1--will help decentralized apps eat the world.

The Role

The Monad Foundation is looking for a Head of Japan to win large institutional business and establish Monad as credible financial infrastructure in one of the world's most important capital markets.

This is, first and foremost, an institutional business development role. Japan is a high-value but demanding market: serious adoption follows local credibility, regulated channels, and trusted relationships. Your primary mandate is to identify, structure, and close institutional deals with Japan's leading financial institutions, enterprises, and infrastructure providers across payments, stablecoins, tokenization/RWA, and capital markets.

Alongside that, you will own Monad's brand presence in Japan — building the foundation's reputation, relationships, and mindshare with the institutions, regulators, and ecosystem partners who shape the market. You will be Monad Foundation's senior representative in the country and the owner of its Japan strategy end to end.

What You Will Do

Win institutional business (primary mandate)

  • Own institutional business development for Japan: identify, negotiate, and close strategic deals that put real activity, flows, and assets on Monad, across megabanks, trust banks, securities firms, payment companies, exchanges, and large enterprises.

  • Build and structure commercial partnerships in Monad's priority pillars: stablecoin issuance and payments, tokenization and RWAs, on-chain settlement, and institutional capital markets use cases.

  • Develop senior relationships with the institutions that matter most in Japan and convert them into concrete launches with clear owners, timelines, and usage paths.

  • Help build the prerequisites for serious BD to scale: regulated pathways for stablecoins on Monad, exchange relationships, and the local credibility that institutional counterparties require before they commit.

  • Run deals with commercial discipline — clear milestones, real product launches, and a usage path beyond announcements and vanity partnerships.

Establish Monad's brand and presence (secondary mandate)

  • Own Monad's overall go-to-market and positioning in Japan, building the foundation's reputation as credible, long-term financial infrastructure rather than just another blockchain.

  • Build and nurture relationships with key regional stakeholders — exchanges, enterprises, ecosystem builders, media, and regulatory bodies, to expand Monad's standing and mindshare.

  • Represent Monad Foundation at the senior level with institutions, partners, and the local industry, and serve as the trusted face of Monad Foundation in the market.

  • Stay ahead of Japan's evolving regulatory landscape (FSA, JVCEA, and related bodies) and translate it into high-impact opportunities and a clear-eyed view of what is and isn't possible.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of business development experience, including 4+ years in blockchain, digital assets, or Web3 with a track record of closing large, complex institutional deals.

  • Deep understanding of the Japanese market and extensive experience engaging and selling to Japan's largest financial institutions and enterprises.

  • A robust, senior network across Japanese banks, trust banks, securities firms, payment companies, enterprises, and Web3 players and the ability to open doors at decision-maker level.

  • Strong command of how Web3 maps to institutional strategy — why an institution would issue a stablecoin, tokenize an asset, or move settlement on-chain, and where the real commercial value sits.

  • Sharp read on where major Japanese corporates and regulators are heading on digital assets, and the foresight to position Monad early.

  • A self-starter who owns initiatives from first conversation to closed deal and live launch.

  • Native-level fluency in Japanese and professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

Nice to Have

  • Deep connectivity into Japanese exchanges and an understanding of the listing landscape.

  • Considerable expertise and relationships with Japanese regulators and industry bodies.

  • Experience guiding market entry for Web3 startups, including strategic guidance, local insight, and connectivity.

  • Strong understanding of and connectivity into Japanese financial and tech media.

  • Entrepreneurial experience across the startup lifecycle, including fundraising, product launches, and operations.

  • Solid technical understanding of blockchains and the EVM.

Location

  • This role is based in Japan (Tokyo).

Why Work with Us

  • Challenging problems. You’ll tackle deeply complex and technically demanding problems, with autonomy and impact.

  • Endless Opportunity for Impact. The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) standard is ubiquitous, but existing EVM-compatible chains are slow and bandwidth-constrained. Monad’s core innovations offer developers and founders the best of both worlds (portability and performance) and are a game-changer to power global on-chain finance.

  • The right team. You’ll be part of a world class team, who are exceptional and highly-motivated.

  • Culture. We’re a lean team working together to achieve very ambitious goals. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output.

  • Strong Ecosystem. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.

jobs.title: Head of Korea
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Monad Foundation is a team of dedicated ecosystem and community builders who are on a mission to massively grow the impact of decentralized tech. We believe that the Monad blockchain--the performant and parallel EVM Layer 1--will help decentralized apps eat the world.

The Role

The Monad Foundation is looking for a Head of Korea to establish Monad as the leading blockchain in South Korea by institutional and retail adoption. South Korea is one of the most dynamic and active blockchain markets globally, with a highly engaged investor community.

You’ll own the overall strategy for the South Korean market, driving business development, strategic relationships and ecosystem growth. You will serve as Monad Foundation’s key representative to major Korean enterprises and institutions, covering use cases such as payments, tokenization/RWA, and capital markets.

 

What You Will Do

  • Develop, own, and execute go to market strategies to establish Monad as an industry leader in the South Korean market among institutional and retail investors.

  • Own business development strategy and execution by identifying, negotiating and closing strategic deals that position Monad as a top chain amongst Korean enterprises and institutions.

  • Build and nurture relationships with strategic regional stakeholders including regional exchanges, enterprises,, media and regulatory bodies to expand Monad’s presence and mindshare.

  • Stay on top of the evolving South Korean regulatory landscape and trends to identify high-impact opportunities to position Monad as an industry leader and first-mover.

     

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of business development experience, including 3+ years in blockchain, digital assets, or Web3 startups.

  • Deep understanding of the South Korean market and extensive experience in engaging and selling some of the largest enterprises and institutions in Korea.

  • Proven ability to engage retail and institutional investors.

  • Considerable market foresight in terms of what major corporations are doing in crypto and where the regulatory landscape is headed.

  • Robust network across regional institutions, enterprises, and web3 companies.

  • Deep understanding of web3 in the context of corporate strategy and how to effectively apply web3 technologies (e.g. why launch a stablecoin, benefits of tokenization, etc.)

  • Self-starter who takes ownership of initiatives from ideation to execution.

  • Native-level fluency in both Korean and English (written and verbal).


Nice to Have

  • Extensive experience guiding market entry for web3 startups (e.g., providing strategic guidance, local insights and connectivity).

  • Deep connectivity into Korean centralized exchanges

  • Considerable expertise and connectivity with regulators

  • Robust understanding and connectivity into Korean media

jobs.title: Director of Business Development, Financial Institutions
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Monad Foundation is a team of dedicated ecosystem and community builders who are on a mission to massively grow the impact of decentralized tech. We believe that the Monad blockchain--the performant and parallel EVM Layer 1--will help decentralized apps eat the world.

The Role

We’re looking for a Director of Business Development | Financial Institutions to build out the Financial Institutions vertical for the Monad Foundation. This is an entrepreneurial, high-autonomy role for someone who thrives on building from zero, identifying opportunities, forming partnerships, and creating momentum around real financial usage on the blockchain.

This is a dual-mandate role. On one side, you will own Monad's financial institution relationships — building the pipeline, advisor network, and institutional narrative that positions Monad as the chain of choice when banks, exchanges, and market infrastructure providers evaluate where to build on-chain. On the other hand, you will own the operational backbone of Monad's institutional communications function — keeping stakeholders informed, tracking ecosystem and token health, and ensuring this function runs with consistency and quality.

What You Will Do

Financial Institutions – BD & Advisory

  • Build and manage a structured pipeline of target financial institutions — banks, exchanges, clearing houses, asset managers, and market infrastructure providers (e.g CME, ICE/NYSE, DTCC, Nasdaq etc) — tracking each organization across stages of engagement: awareness, evaluation, pilot, and committed.

  • Develop deep, trust-based relationships with senior decision-makers at major financial institutions, with a focus on the individuals and teams responsible for blockchain strategy, digital assets, and infrastructure decisions.

  • Cultivate internal champions within each target institution, recognizing that institutional decisions involve multiple stakeholders and that durable progress requires building a coalition, not relying on a single relationship.

  • Develop and execute an advisor and influencer strategy — identifying and engaging the consulting firms, advisors, and intermediaries that shape how financial institutions think about chain selection. These relationships often have more bearing on institutional decisions than direct BD efforts alone.

  • Maintain a real-time, working view of which institutions are evaluating competing chains and infrastructure, and the underlying drivers of those evaluations. Develop a sharp, insightful positioning for why Monad is the better fit for specific institutional use cases.

  • Build Monad's presence in the forums, working groups, and industry bodies where institutional blockchain strategy is formed.

  • Develop and maintain Monad's institutional narrative — a clear, compelling, and technically credible articulation of why Monad is the right infrastructure partner for financial institutions building on-chain.

MON Ecosystem & Institutional Communications

  • Own the operational cadence of institutional communications: drafting regular ecosystem updates, preparing materials for calls and meetings, and maintaining a consistent outreach rhythm with current and prospective institutional stakeholders.

  • Monitor sentiment across institutional channels, identifying shifts in perception early and surfacing them internally with context and recommended responses.

  • Support the development and refinement of Monad's institutional narrative, ensuring stakeholders have a clear and differentiated understanding of what Monad is building and why it matters.

  • Manage the logistics and follow-through of institutional relationships — ensuring no current stakeholder or warm prospect goes dark due to operational gaps.

Who You Are

Background

  • 6-10 years of experience in one or more of the following: financial institution partnerships, institutional BD, management consulting with a financial services focus, or a crypto infrastructure company where you have seen the pipeline of institutions looking to build on the blockchain.

  • Direct exposure to how large financial institutions evaluate, procure, and adopt new technology infrastructure — you understand the internal dynamics, stakeholders, and timelines involved.

  • Existing relationships within financial institutions, consulting firms, or the broader institutional crypto ecosystem that give you a running start.

Skills

  • Exceptional written communication — investor updates, institutional materials, and narrative documents you produce should be clear, precise, and credible without requiring heavy editing.

  • Familiarity with token markets and institutional investor behavior — you understand how institutional allocators think about digital assets, what drives conviction, and what erodes it.

  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams with different audiences and timelines simultaneously, without dropping quality on either.

  • Analytically sharp enough to track competitive dynamics across chains and synthesize institutional feedback into actionable intelligence.

Why Work with Us

  • Challenging problems. You’ll tackle deeply complex and technically demanding problems, with autonomy and impact.

  • Endless Opportunity for Impact. The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) standard is ubiquitous, but existing EVM-compatible chains are slow and bandwidth-constrained. Monad’s core innovations offer developers and founders the best of both worlds (portability and performance) and are a game-changer to power global on-chain finance.

  • The right team. You’ll be part of a world class team, who are exceptional and highly-motivated.

  • Culture. We’re a lean team working together to achieve very ambitious goals. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output.

  • Strong Ecosystem. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.

WHO YOU ARE


BACKGROUND

 - 6-10 years of experience in one or more of the following: financial institution partnerships, institutional BD, management consulting with a financial services focus, or a crypto infrastructure company where you have seen the pipeline of institutions looking to build on the blockchain.

 - Direct exposure to how large financial institutions evaluate, procure, and adopt new technology infrastructure — you understand the internal dynamics, stakeholders, and timelines involved.

 - Existing relationships within financial institutions, consulting firms, or the broader institutional crypto ecosystem that give you a running start.


SKILLS

 - Exceptional written communication — investor updates, institutional materials, and narrative documents you produce should be clear, precise, and credible without requiring heavy editing.

 - Familiarity with token markets and institutional investor behavior — you understand how institutional allocators think about digital assets, what drives conviction, and what erodes it.

 - Comfortable managing multiple workstreams with different audiences and timelines simultaneously, without dropping quality on either.

 - Analytically sharp enough to track competitive dynamics across chains and synthesize institutional feedback into actionable intelligence.


WHY WORK WITH US

 - Challenging problems. You’ll tackle deeply complex and technically demanding problems, with autonomy and impact.

 - Endless Opportunity for Impact. The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) standard is ubiquitous, but existing EVM-compatible chains are slow and bandwidth-constrained. Monad’s core innovations offer developers and founders the best of both worlds (portability and performance) and are a game-changer to power global on-chain finance.

 - The right team. You’ll be part of a world class team, who are exceptional and highly-motivated.

 - Culture. We’re a lean team working together to achieve very ambitious goals. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output.

 - Strong Ecosystem. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.

jobs.title: Business Development Lead, AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Monad Foundation is a team of dedicated ecosystem and community builders who are on a mission to massively grow the impact of decentralized tech. We believe that the Monad blockchain--the performant and parallel EVM Layer 1--will help decentralized apps eat the world.

The Role

AI is coming onchain. Compute is becoming a tradeable asset. Agents are starting to pay each other. Monad wants to be where it settles.

Monad Foundation, a core contributor to the Monad protocol, is looking for a Business Development Lead for AI & Compute to own the ecosystem at the intersection of AI infrastructure, agentic applications, and onchain markets. You'll build relationships with AI founders, venture firms, and compute providers and turn those relationships into early-stage teams building and launching on Monad.

Your focus is where AI meets onchain markets: tradable compute, agentic payments, and the capital markets forming around them. We’re looking for a Business Development Leadwho can identify where Monad adds value, close commercial deals, and make Monad a preferred settlement layer for live AI and compute products, backed by the Foundation’s resources and network.

What You Will Do

  • Own sourcing and activation. Build Monad’s presence in San Francisco through founders and the wider AI community. Develop the existing pipeline and source new teams, owning qualification, follow-up, deployment, and launch.

  • Build venture and capital relationships. Develop durable relationships with venture firms and crypto-native capital, turning introductions into qualified opportunities and teams building on Monad.

  • Drive the compute-markets strategy. Recruit protocols, index providers, curators, liquidity providers, compute operators, and trading partners. Develop collaborations around compute index vaults, lending against tokenized compute, and hedging products that bring liquidity and volume to Monad.

  • Drive agentic payments. Find and activate teams building agent-driven and stablecoin payments, including x402 and emerging payment models. Convert integrations into real transaction activity.

  • Structure and close collaborations. Understand each business and make the case for Monad. Negotiate commercial arrangements across company stages, connecting traditional financial structuring with onchain execution and settlement.

  • Turn strategy into measurable outcomes. Coordinate technical, ecosystem, DeFi, communications, and legal support. Set priorities and milestones, remove launch blockers, and track live products, users, payments, liquidity, and sustained volume.

Who You Are

  • A record of closing and launching. You’ve taken BD or strategic partnerships from an initial conversation to a working product, including with growth or late-stage businesses.

  • Strong AI and compute relationships. You understand AI business models and can bring together founders, venture investors, GPU providers, neoclouds, trading firms, and market makers.

  • Founder empathy and follow-through. You can explain why Monad matters to a partner, earn trust, bring in technical expertise, and sustain momentum through a complex integration.

  • Autonomy and judgment. You build your own pipeline, prioritize real use cases, set clear success and failure criteria, and stop investing in weak opportunities. You collaborate with low ego and stay effective without a playbook.

  • Based in San Francisco. You want to build relationships in person and spend time with the AI, compute, and crypto communities across the Bay Area.

Why Work with Us

  • Challenging problems. You’ll tackle deeply complex and technically demanding problems, with autonomy and impact.

  • Endless Opportunity for Impact. The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) standard is ubiquitous, but existing EVM-compatible chains are slow and bandwidth-constrained. Monad’s core innovations offer developers and founders the best of both worlds (portability and performance) and are a game-changer to power global on-chain finance.

  • The right team. You’ll be part of a world class team, who are exceptional and highly-motivated.

  • Culture. We’re a lean team working together to achieve very ambitious goals. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output.

  • Strong Ecosystem. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.
